digest.component_or_area: store write lock acquisition and retry
propositions: A store write whose lock acquisition times out is permanently discarded without retry or queueing, causing terminal data loss when holder duration exceeds the acquisition budget

The acquire() function computes a single deadline from timeout * attempts, making attempts a silent multiplier rather than a retry loop, with both fcntl and mkdir legs polling non-deterministically without fairness
Holder durations of 70s-103s routinely exceed the 60s budget and cause writes to be lost regardless of writer count, even in production Jira DC CI runs and plan-review operations

Bounded retry-with-backoff inside acquire() converts lock timeouts to latency rather than loss, by re-attempting acquisitions across multiple passes with exponential backoff, without risking double-write of the guarded body
Five specific call sites opt into retry via retries parameter and REBAR_LOCK_RETRIES env var (default 2, clamped [0,10]), while all other callers preserve fail-fast behavior via retries=0 default
The retry ceiling of ~181.5s (3 passes × 60s + 1.5s backoff) encompasses typical holder durations and failed field occurrences while remaining bounded
